title: Egyptian Chicken Shawarma
description: A keto-friendly twist on the classic Middle Eastern street food, featuring juicy chicken, crispy flatbread, and a side of zesty tahini sauce.

ingredients.name: Flatbread
ingredients.notes: Keto flatbread or low-carb flatbread alternative

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: Typically includes cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season chicken breast with Egyptian spices and salt, and pepper to taste.
Grill chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Slice cooked chicken into thin strips.
Warm flatbreads by wrapping them in foil and heating in the oven for 2-3 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by placing chicken on flatbread and topping with zesty tahini sauce.
